text:
olivia: Postmortem follow-up: sketching the rehearsal plan for DR/regional failover. I'll list owners and rough ETAs — please ack and update.

ravi: Ack. I'll take network/runbook items: BGP withdraw test cases, transit route priorities. ETA: doc + test matrix by 2026-03-25.

maris: I'll own backup snapshot integrity checks and restore timing validation. Need a disposable S3 bucket and a restore VM. ETA: checkpoints + sample run 3/23.

dan: I'll do the traffic shaping and sticky-session test harness. Will add a header-based sticky client simulator. ETA: 3/27.

sam: I'll coordinate the game-day schedule and oncall rotation. Proposed rehearse window: 2026-03-30 08:00-12:00 PT (dry run) and 2026-04-02 09:00-13:00 PT (full).

olivia: Recurring incident pattern we saw: BGP withdraws that don't fully propagate -> clients keep sending to old region -> stale KV shards -> restore conflicts. We need end-to-end checks that detect that exact chain.

ravi: Adding tests: 1) withdraw a region's routes and verify route table convergence within Xs, 2) simulate route flaps and ensure control-plane de-dup logic holds.

maris: For backups: will add a WAL replay timing test and test snapshot consistency across regions. If WAL lag > 30s -> mark as degraded.

dan: Sticky session harness will simulate 10k clients with header X-Session-ID and assert requests succeed after failover. Will run with synthetic load.

sam: Game day scope: routing withdrawal, snapshot restore, WAL replay, sticky-session continuity, and KV consistency checks.

ops-bot: Created Jira RINF-2026-470: "Network failover test matrix + BGP scenarios" assigned to ravi, due 2026-03-25.

ops-bot: Created Jira RINF-2026-471: "Snapshot & WAL validation plan" assigned to maris, due 2026-03-23.

ci-bot: Created pipeline job: ci/game-day-rehearsal (runs tests in sandbox cluster). Trigger with /ci run game-day-rehearsal.

olivia: Important: include an explicit check for client-side sticky TTLs and a step to purge caches. If clients cache DNS for too long we must have a mitigation.

ravi: Noted. I'll add DNS TTL stepping in the plan and a rollback knob to re-advertise routes.

maris: Will add restore-check command snippet to the runbook: 
```bash
# restore-check example
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/latest-snapshot.tar.gz /tmp && \
  tar -xzf /tmp/latest-snapshot.tar.gz -C /tmp/restore && \
  ./wal-replay --dir /tmp/restore || exit 1
```

dan: Adding traffic command example: 
```bash
# sticky sim
./client-sim --clients 10000 --session-header X-Session-ID --target us-west,eu
```

sam: Can we feature-flag the new route preference so we can turn it on only during the rehearsal? Also want a canary so we can abort if latency spikes.

olivia: Yes, feature flag + canary. Also make sure dashboards include routing-drop-rate, restore-duration, kv-consistency-errors.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal dry-run standup scheduled 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC.

maris: Requesting sandbox creds for restore VM from infra. @olivia can you escalate?

olivia: Escalating now. Infra should provide a time-limited key. Will post here when ready.

ravi: I'll include a checklist for post-rehearsal validation: route convergence time, percentage of sticky sessions failed, restore latency percentile, any manual rollbacks.

dan: I'll wire alerts to #eng-oncall for any >5% sticky failures or restore > 5m.

sam: I'll publish calendar invites and include runbook links: https://docs.redwood.internal/playbooks/dr-rehearsal (please don't share externally).

olivia: OK — summary: RINF-2026-470 (ravi) BGP/test matrix by 3/25; RINF-2026-471 (maris) snapshot/WAL by 3/23; RINF-2026-472 (dan) sticky harness by 3/27; RINF-2026-473 (sam) schedule & invites by 3/24. Update Jiras as you make progress.

maris: Acked. Will post initial restore logs once done.

ravi: Ack. Will draft BGP scenarios doc and link tests.

dan: Ack. Will push client-sim to the game-day repo.

sam: Ack. Will confirm oncall slots and publish the invite today. :calendar:

ops-bot: Follow-up standup reminder set for 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.
